notablePrerequisites: If Jirina is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Jirina is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
description:
Cast Jirina by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Jirina from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Jirina.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Jirina and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Jirina by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Jirina from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
